in_arabic.name: منظورۃ
in_arabic.long_meaning: المانِظورِۃ المُوَقَوفُ عَلى الرِضا: الَّذي يَنظُرُ إِلَیكَ بِقُبولِ القَلبي وَالتِحتَينِ وَالهِمَمِ الَّتي فِي القَلبي وَالهِمَمِ الَّتي فِي التِحتَينِ، وَهُوَ إِذا أَعجَبَ بِشَيءٍ فَيَقولُ: رُبَّما كُنتُ أَمانِعُهُ وَإِذا اِستَجابَ لِدَعوَتِكَ فَيَقولُ: لَقَد رُدِعَ بِكَ

in_english.name: Manzoorat
in_english.meaning: The one who is pleased with you, the one who sees you with favor
in_english.long_meaning: Manzoorat is an Arabic name that means 'the one who is pleased with you' or 'the one who sees you with favor'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'n-z-r' which means 'to see' or 'to look at'. In Islamic tradition, Manzoorat is associated with the concept of Allah's pleasure and favor. It is said to be the name of a person who is blessed with Allah's pleasure and favor, and who is guided by Allah's wisdom. In Sufism, Manzoorat is considered a state of spiritual growth and development, where the individual is able to see the world with the eyes of Allah's pleasure and favor.
